title: Jungle Bungle
overview: After Uncle Max draws Koko the Clown and a jungle, he orders Koko to stay out and forbids Mean Max and Kokette from entering. Once he leaves, Mean Max emerges with a rifle and heads into the jungle, followed by Koko and Kokette. A gorilla captures Kokette, and Koko and Mean Max pursue them, facing a chasm, crocodile, lion, and other dangers. Eventually, the pair become trapped by a wire. Kokette tricks the gorilla into slipping on a banana peel and knocking itself unconscious, then frees the others. All three return safely to their inkwells before Uncle Max comes back.
